Rish is an experimental native app for conversations and local workspaces. Its
interface is written

in Rust with GPUI Mobile on iOS/Android and GPUI Fast for
the macOS preview. The repository now cont

ains the GPUI app and its native
runtime services; the previous React Native application has been re

he GPUI app and its native
runtime services; the previous React Native application has been removed.
## Current scope

- Shared GPUI interface with a compact navigation drawer, a wide-window sidebar,
light/dark themes,

Lucide icons, and English/Chinese UI strings.
- Basic native text chat, saved conversations, model/r

easoning configuration,
and native message/name editors on mobile.
- Provider-owned model catalogs f

etched from the configured service or entered
manually, with no bundled model choices or automatic f

allback model.
- Create folders and UTF-8 text files, and edit files up to 256 KiB in the
native edi

tor. Saves check the original revision; failed saves retain a draft.
- Native platform services reta

in ownership of provider credentials, network
calls, workspace files, Git, and runtime execution. Se

ssion mutations use the
shared Rust validator and generation/digest compare-and-swap.

This is a development preview. **The full Agent controller and tool workflows,
attachments, complete

settings, and task Live Activity integration are not yet
complete in the GPUI interface.** An expor

ted native method is not evidence of
an end-to-end working feature. Existing account/provider verifi

cation and
screenshots from the old app do not establish GPUI acceptance.

The development app uses `tech.zseven.rish.gpui` and its own data container.
Previously installed ap

ps and their data are not automatically migrated.
The macOS build is a UI preview without the mobile

runtime. There is no verified
GPUI TestFlight or signed release pipeline yet.
